conditions_stated.value: The long he wanted, as a testable rule: (1) wait for the 10:00 news; (2) price trades down into the equilibrium (0.5) of the range, ≈18,587 on the 5m range or ≈18,622 on the 1m post-news range; (3) price sweeps sell-side liquidity just below and reverses; (4) go long targeting the highs at 18,672.75–18,677. He says conditions (2) and (3) happened, but he did not take the trade.
